title: Graduate Engineering Program (civil)
location: Central Victoria (Bendigo) or Queensland / Northern NSW offices
content_text: Westera Partners careers page (read 9 Oct 2026 AEST), Graduate Program section: 'Whether you have graduated from university, or you are looking for work experience as an undergraduate, we are looking for candidates with motivation and passion to join our industry.' 'Our 4-year Graduate Engineering Program produces confident mid-level engineers with an opportunity to achieve their professional accreditation status.' Graduate Engineers join teams and are mentored by Senior Engineers. 'If you would like to apply for a graduate position ... please email your resume, academic transcript, application letter (including your preferred office and discipline of engineering) and resume to HR' (mailto:HR@westerapartners.com.au). Offices: Brisbane, Gold Coast, Sunshine Coast, Northern NSW, Central Victoria. Disciplines: Civil, Structural and Environmental engineering.
apply_instructions: Email HR@westerapartners.com.au with resume, academic transcript and an application letter naming preferred office and discipline (careers page Graduate Program section).
